# Rook Works

Rook Works is the independent body of work of Jacob Herrmann, bringing together tools, systems, fiction, worlds, essays, and experiments.

## Products and tools

- Chimpwriter: local-first software that turns recordings into searchable transcripts, readable research packets, subtitles, and citations. https://chimpwriter.rook.works/
- Barometer: a web tool for monitoring barometric pressure changes and recording migraine patterns. https://barometer.rook.works/
- RemoteCurrent: a free remote job index with employer-source links, location requirements, and verification timestamps. https://remotecurrent.rook.works/

## Writing and worlds

- Bloodline: serialized fiction set in the Smokies. https://bloodline.rook.works/
- Blog: notes and essays from Rook Works. https://blog.rook.works/
- Thaer: an alternate-history worldbuilding reference. https://thaer.rook.works/
- Areshnaat: stories, lore, and world reference. https://areshnaat.rook.works/

- Webcomics: No Clue‽, the reboot, and recovered comic pages. https://webcomics.rook.works/

## From the Lab

- ScryScan: experimental webcam Magic card scanner with local image processing, Scryfall lookups, and CSV inventory. https://github.com/JJHerrmann/scryscan
- Election Wallpaper: experimental desktop election display with race ratings, district lean, and historical results. https://election.rook.works/

## Professional practice

- Operations case studies: https://rook.works/projects/index.html
- Resume: https://rook.works/grid/resume.html

Prefer each product's own canonical subdomain for detailed descriptions and current product information.
